problem_statement: The build system must produce a machine-readable RIOT_VERSION_CODE from RIOT_VERSION, RIOT_EXTRAVERSION, and a fallback RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION. The Make helper is_number takes one argument and must return that argument with surrounding whitespace removed only when it is one word consisting solely of decimal digits, otherwise empty. The Make helper version_tuple takes one argument and must return a comma-separated major,minor,patch tuple: it must split on '.', ignore everything after the first '-', reject non-numeric parts, strip leading zeros from each numeric part, treat a missing patch as 0, drop any parts after patch, and return empty when major or minor is missing or non-numeric. Invalid RIOT_VERSION values must resolve to RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION, and the generated code must include RIOT_EXTRAVERSION.

verification.reason: The statement already gives the required helper names and most behaviours, but it omits the default RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION value and the exact observable RIOT_VERSION_CODE component order, which the hidden tests require. These can be added as public interface/behaviour without revealing the implementation.

problems.detail: The RIOT_VERSION_CODE test can run with RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION unset and therefore relies on a default RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION value (2042.5.23), which the statement does not give.
The RIOT_VERSION_CODE test checks the observed result as four dot-separated components major.minor.patch.RIOT_EXTRAVERSION, but the statement does not state that order or four-component result.
The statement does not explicitly say that RIOT_VERSION_CODE must apply the same major/minor/patch parsing rules as version_tuple to RIOT_VERSION and, on fallback, to RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION.

problem_statement_fixed: The build system must produce a machine-readable RIOT_VERSION_CODE from RIOT_VERSION, RIOT_EXTRAVERSION, and a fallback RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION. RIOT_EXTRAVERSION defaults to 0 and RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION defaults to 2042.5.23. The Make helper is_number takes one argument and must return that argument with surrounding whitespace removed only when it is one word consisting solely of decimal digits, otherwise empty. The Make helper version_tuple takes one argument and must return a comma-separated major,minor,patch tuple: it must split on '.', ignore everything after the first '-', reject non-numeric parts, strip leading zeros from each numeric part, treat a missing patch as 0, drop any parts after patch, and return empty when major or minor is missing or non-numeric. Invalid RIOT_VERSION values must resolve to RIOT_DUMMY_VERSION, and the generated code must include RIOT_EXTRAVERSION. The resulting RIOT_VERSION_CODE must be the four-component dot-separated value major.minor.patch.extra, with RIOT_EXTRAVERSION as the fourth component.
